properties.name: app.security.actuator.api-key
properties.description: Actuator API key used by the management filter.

properties.name: app.runs.max-published-per-user
properties.description: Maximum number of published compliance runs retained per user.

properties.name: app.compliance.min-publish-score
properties.description: Minimum Core RFC Conformance percentage required to publish a validation run.

properties.name: app.compliance.min-core-coverage-percent
properties.description: Minimum percentage of testable core RFC requirements that must be executed to publish a validation run.

properties.name: app.compliance.public-base-url
properties.description: Public base URL used when constructing published report and badge URLs.

properties.name: app.compliance.sample-run-ids
properties.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of official sample fixture runs.

properties.name: app.compliance.reservation-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Seconds before a pending publication reservation is treated as stale and retryable.

properties.name: app.compliance.reservation-cleanup-interval-ms
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between background sweeps that purge stale pending publication reservations.

properties.name: app.github.publish.enabled
properties.description: Whether 1-click GitHub compliance directory publishing is enabled.

properties.name: app.github.app-id
properties.description: GitHub App ID used for installation token exchange.

properties.name: app.github.installation-id
properties.description: GitHub App installation ID for the target compliance repository.

properties.name: app.github.private-key
properties.description: PEM-encoded RSA private key for the GitHub App.

properties.name: app.github.repo
properties.description: Target GitHub repository (owner/repo) for compliance directory publications.

properties.name: app.github.branch
properties.description: Target base branch in the GitHub compliance repository.
